Capabilities.Description: SQLite monotonically allocates a durable Int64 key in the insert command; concurrent commit order may differ and no additional provider command is required.
Commits all staged writes across declared SQLite storage units in one provider transaction.
The deployment enforces declared physical foreign keys and portable check constraints in its native catalog.
Provides durable idempotent appends on SQLite; ledger and payload are committed atomically.
Executes grouped writes through the provider's native multi-row command or bulk-write primitive.
Returns one outcome per staged row for SQLite; exact evidence cost: one RETURNING result per native batch.
Stages and coalesces writes for SQLite; uses variable-limit-aware multi-row INSERT/UPSERT commands; secondary unique declarations use the row-attributed fallback.
Deletes one identified row on SQLite only when every declared equality value matches in one provider-owned atomic decision/transaction; zero-row outcomes distinguish absence from comparison mismatch.
Returns the committed scoped ProviderSequence high-water on SQLite; the value survives retention and provider/session restart.
Returns replay-stable exact generated outcomes on SQLite; result evidence is stored in the idempotency ledger.
Replays operation-identified retention results on SQLite; the operation ledger and cleanup are durable.
Returns complete, distinct, deterministically ordered affected projection values on SQLite; the finite bound is checked before row mutation and the values are persisted for replay.
Updates or deletes every row matching an index-covered portable predicate on SQLite in one UPDATE/DELETE statement; the statement is atomic and reports its affected-row count.

MongoDB monotonically allocates a sequence in a counter collection and commits it with the row in a transaction-capable deployment; concurrent commit order may differ and each inserted row/coalesced exact write uses one additional counter command.

Provides durable idempotent appends on MongoDB; ledger and payload are committed atomically.

Returns one outcome per staged row for MongoDB; exact evidence cost: one FindOneAndUpdate per coalesced row.
Stages and coalesces writes for MongoDB; uses unordered BulkWrite for aggregate commits.

Updates or deletes every document matching an index-covered portable predicate on MongoDB with one updateMany/deleteMany, and reports matchedCount/deletedCount. Unlike the relational providers, a multi-document updateMany/deleteMany is atomic only when it runs inside a transaction: open a unit of work on a transaction-capable deployment when the whole set must apply or none of it.
